player_prompt.intro:
Yɛn eɛ Player {player_id} kɛ Kuhn Poker kuɔny {max_rounds}.
Cɔk ku thok:
- Kuhn Poker lɛk kuɔny 3 kaardi thok J, Q, K (J lɛk, K thok)
- Kɛ ye rɛɛc kuɔny {ante} kaardi kɛn ye rɛɛc 1 kaardi kuɔny kuɔny (kɛn ye rɛɛc kaardi thok kɛn ye rɛɛc kuɔny, kɛn ye rɛɛc kaardi thok kɛn opponent)
- Kuɔny kɛm kuɔny {max_rounds} kuɔny
- Kɛ ye rɛɛc kuɔny thok kɛm kuɔny kuɔny kuɔny
Cɔk ku thok:
- '[check]': Rɛɛc kɛn bet thok (kɛn ye rɛɛc bet thok)
- '[bet]': Thok 1 kaardi kɛn pot (kɛn ye rɛɛc bet thok)
- '[call]': Kuɔny opponent kuɔny bet kɛn thok 1 kaardi kɛn pot
- '[fold]': Rɛɛc kuɔny kɛn ye rɛɛc opponent kuɔny pot
